summary: Full-app operational check after emergentintegrations removal + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY removal + backend restart. Ran full pytest suite (30 tests: backend_test.py + test_gemini_public_chat.py) — 30/30 PASSED in ~20s. Frontend UI walkthrough via Playwright on the public preview URL: login page renders and prefills demo creds; email/password login as admin@autoacquire.ai lands on /app/dashboard with hot leads / needs review / new leads / appointments panels populated and no onboarding overlay blocking (seeded admin has onboarding_complete=true as expected). Nav to /app/leads, /app/inventory, /app/appointments, /app/analytics, /app/settings all succeed via nav-* data-testids without console errors. Public seller chat /sell/prestige-auto-toronto shows AI greeting; sending 'I want to sell my 2021 Toyota RAV4 with 42000 km, fully paid off' returned a REAL contextual Gemini reply ('That 2021 Toyota RAV4 sounds great, and it's helpful to know it's fully paid off! ... has the vehicle been in any accidents or had any major repairs?') — NOT the FALLBACK_MESSAGE. GET /api/public/prestige-auto-toronto returns 200. The reported 'preview stopped working' was transient (backend restart blip); the app is fully operational end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_engine.py: exceptions from google-genai are swallowed into result['raw'] without logging.exception — quota/model errors are only diagnosable by reading test output. Add a logger.exception call on the except path so future FALLBACK_MESSAGE regressions are visible in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log.

ai_engine.py uses os.environ['GEMINI_API_KEY'] (subscript) which will raise KeyError at first orchestrator call if the env var is missing. A startup check with a clear log line would fail fast instead.

Seller chat send button has no visible text and no explicit data-testid (only a paper-plane icon). Tests had to fall back to Enter-key submission. Adding data-testid="seller-chat-send" would improve test/a11y.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, dashboard, all nav tabs, public seller chat with live Gemini reply)

test_credentials: admin@autoacquire.ai / Admin123! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Public seller chat needs no auth; slug prestige-auto-toronto.
seed_data_creation: Seeded a couple of throwaway public-chat conversations + leads while exercising the Gemini flow (source=web_conversation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is healthy post-cleanup. GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-flash-latest is the working model on the user's Gemini key; do NOT switch back to gemini-3.1-pro-preview (429 quota). If a future run sees FALLBACK_MESSAGE, first tail /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log for google.genai errors. Existing test suites /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and test_gemini_public_chat.py cover the critical backend paths and are safe to re-run for regression.
rca of the issue: No bug present at test time. Reported 'preview stopped working' was a transient blip during the backend restart that followed removing emergentintegrations from requirements.txt and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from backend/.env. Post-restart, supervisor shows backend RUNNING (uptime healthy), all 30 pytest cases pass, and the UI + live Gemini chat work end-to-end from the public preview URL.
